_readme: Templated projects (SYSTEMS §5), 2–3 per domain (PROTOTYPE_SCOPE). Costs and effects are PROPOSED P0-08; Attention costs tuned so demand ≥ 1.5× supply (DECIDED 2026-09-26). Tags are checked against SYSTEMS §14 hard constraints by ContentChecks.

projects.name: Repair the district fountain
projects.description: The Subura's fountain runs brown. Clear the lead pipe and reline the basin.
projects.completionText: Clean water runs again in the district fountain.

projects.name: Fund a physician for the district
projects.description: Pay a trained Greek physician to treat the district's poor.
projects.completionText: A physician now keeps open hours in the Subura.

projects.name: Draft quarantine rules for Ostia's docks
projects.description: Work with the harbor officials on rules for holding sick crews offshore.
projects.completionText: Ostia's harbor officials adopt your quarantine rules.

projects.name: Patronage for a senator
projects.description: Fund a senator's games and debts in exchange for his ear.
projects.completionText: A senator now owes you favors.

projects.name: Fund the district magistrates
projects.description: Pay clerks and lamp oil so the district's disputes are actually heard.
projects.completionText: The district magistrates hear cases again, and people bring them.

projects.name: Sponsor a household census
projects.description: Count the households of the district, street by street.
projects.completionText: For the first time, someone knows who lives in the district.

projects.name: Buy into the smith's workshop
projects.description: Pay for a second forge and paid apprentices at the smith's by the Porta Trigemina, in exchange for a share of the business.
projects.completionText: The smith's second forge is lit, and part of the workshop is now yours.

projects.name: Market regulation at the Forum Boarium
projects.description: Honest weights and posted prices at the cattle market.
projects.completionText: Honest weights now hang in the Forum Boarium.

projects.name: Repair the Ostia warehouses
projects.description: Re-roof the grain warehouses and hire paid dock crews to keep them dry.
projects.completionText: The Ostia warehouses are dry and full.
